title: Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). translated_title: 面向大语言模型的快速多项式超越函数
translated_abstract: 图形处理器（GPU）各代产品对矩阵管线、特殊函数管线和内存管线的扩展速率各不相同，因此随着硬件的演进，内核瓶颈也会随之转移。FlashAttention-4 在 NVIDIA Blackwell 上揭示了注意力机制内部存在的这种不平衡。我们测试了短多项式程序能否加速大语言模型（LLM）中其他特殊函数单元（SFU）操作。我们首先在一个隔离的 IEEE binary16（FP16）扫描实验中，将原生 PyTorch 评估与打包的融合乘加（FMA）程序进行对比，该扫描涵盖 L2 驻留与高带宽内存（HBM）驻留的工作集。随后，我们在四个 GB200 集成任务中，用三次或四次 bfloat16（BF16）多项式程序替换原生的 sigmoid、tanh 和 sigmoid 线性单元（SiLU）：密集 SiLU、tanh 软上限注意力、sigmoid 注意力以及路由专家的 Swish 门控线性单元。这些程序结合了解析对称性、目标格式舍入以及消费端内部的打包算术。
tldr: 该论文提出用结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与打包算术的短多项式（三次或四次 BF16）程序替换 GPU 原生的 sigmoid、tanh 和 SiLU 等特殊函数运算，以缓解矩阵管线与 SFU 之间的硬件不平衡，从而加速大语言模型在 GB200 上的相关内核计算。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that short degree-3/degree-4 BF16 polynomial programs, combining analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed FMA arithmetic, can replace native SFU operations (sigmoid, tanh, SiLU) to accelerate LLM kernels on GB200 GPUs where matrix and special-function pipelines are unbalanced.
